vulnerabilities.description: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) in email validation & v1 EOL maintenance.
Unintended leakage of Proxy-Authorization header during cross-origin redirects.
FastAPI <0.100.0 crashes when paired with Pydantic v2 runtime.

breaking_changes_detected.description: Pydantic v2 replaces nested class Config with model_config = ConfigDict(...)
Use @field_validator instead of @validator and declare as @classmethod
Replace .dict() calls with .model_dump() for standard dictionary serialization

action_required_in_kepler: Refactor Pydantic v1 class Config and validators into Pydantic v2 format
Verify all pytest cases pass before signaling human approval

instructions_for_kepler: 1. Run dry-run test suite using pytest to detect Pydantic v1->v2 breakage.
2. Apply automated semantic refactoring to service/models.py (replace class Config with model_config = ConfigDict(...)).
3. Re-run pytest to verify all tests are green.
4. Emit Kepler verification signal back to Temporal.
